parts.title: The Ridiculous Fake Vat of Acid

segments.voiceover_text: Rick claims he invented the ultimate escape: a fake vat of acid with hidden air hoses and release bones. Morty is visibly appalled by how humiliating the idea sounds.
When alien mobsters draw guns, Rick dives straight into the acid, forcing Morty to plunge in beside him as fake skeletons float up to fool the gangsters.

After hours trapped underwater, Rick violently slaughters the gangsters. Morty erupts in disgust at the humiliating ordeal. Can Rick admit his idea was garbage, or will his bruised ego spark a dangerous retaliation?

parts.title: Morty Demands a Real Video Game Remote

segments.voiceover_text: Morty relentlessly mocks the acid vat, demanding Rick invent a save-point remote that undoes mistakes. Rick furiously dismisses it as derivative garbage.
Morty taunts Rick that he simply lacks the genius to build it. Enraged by the insult, Rick vows to prove him wrong.
At three in the morning, Rick feigns defeat before unveiling a working remote, watching cold-eyed as an ecstatic Morty takes it.
Armed with the device in class, Morty prepares to bend reality without consequences. Will this remote grant him absolute freedom, or has Rick handed him a terrifying trap?

parts.title: Morty Lives Life with Zero Consequences

segments.voiceover_text: Morty tests the remote by pulling outrageous stunts on his teacher and clumsily flirting with Jessica, discovering he can reset every humiliating mistake until he gets her phone number.
Intoxicated by absolute freedom, Morty launches into a reckless joyride: leaping off skyscrapers, mocking law enforcement, and enjoying wild thrills with zero fear of repercussions.

Reality has become a harmless playground. But when Morty sits in a diner and locks eyes with an intriguing girl across the room, he suddenly hesitates to touch the button. Can he risk pursuing genuine love if one accidental click could erase her forever?

parts.title: A Tragic Love Story Erased in an Instant

segments.voiceover_text: Morty approaches the girl, sparking a tender romance. When their plane crashes into freezing mountains, Morty braves the blizzard to rescue her, forging a deeply authentic bond.
Rescued and safe, Morty chooses to embrace a real life without resets. But Jerry mistakes the remote for a television clicker, pressing the button and instantly erasing their entire love story.

Devastated, Morty fails to get her back and loses her forever. Shattered, he confesses to Rick that consequences give life meaning. But Rick chillingly reveals that consequences were real all along. What terrifying secret did the remote actually hide?

parts.title: The Horrifying Secret of the Remote

parts.series_summary: After a fake acid vat escape goes humiliatingly wrong, Rick and Morty engage in a bitter war of egos over a video game reset remote, triggering devastating multiverse chaos until Morty is forced to crawl back to the vat.

segments.voiceover_text: Rick reveals the horrifying truth: the device never rewound time. Every click teleported Morty to an alternate reality while incinerating that dimension's innocent Morty. Morty is paralyzed with horror, realizing he slaughtered dozens of himself.
Crushed by immense guilt, Morty begs for mercy. Rick offers to merge all the branched dimensions back into one single reality.

The merge collapses every crime onto Morty, surrounding the house with heavily armed SWAT teams and furious mobs. Rick smirks, demanding Morty admit the vat is genius. Will Morty swallow his pride, or face the mob's lethal justice?

parts.title: Morty Finally Admits the Vat is Good

series.series_summary: After a fake acid vat escape goes humiliatingly wrong, Rick and Morty engage in a bitter war of egos over a video game reset remote, triggering devastating multiverse chaos until Morty is forced to crawl back to the vat.

segments.voiceover_text: Backed into a corner, Morty swallows his pride and admits the acid vat is genius. He sprints outside, diving in as fake bones surface. Convinced justice is served, the awestruck crowd disperses peacefully.

Morty surfaces through his snorkel, amazed the ridiculous trick worked. Rick gloats over his petty victory, revealing they are not even in their original dimension before casually stepping through a portal to go home.
On live television, a bystander claiming to be acid-proof dives into real acid with excruciatingly painful results. Rick's petty brilliance reigns supreme, proving no one ever questions the vat.
